name: popsicle
headline: YouTube Assistant: Free Analytics & Trend Analysis
short_description: Transform YouTube research into actionable insights with Google Sheets - Free YouTube analytics tool for content creators and marketers
author: clairechung

sections.overview:
YouTube Assistant is a free analytics tool that transforms YouTube video data into actionable insights within Google Sheets. It fetches 20+ metrics including views, engagement rates, performance scores, and hashtag analysis without requiring expensive third-party platforms. The tool categorizes content by type (Shorts, mid-form, long-form), calculates engagement patterns, and identifies top-performing videos. Content creators and marketers use it to discover winning topics, analyze competitors, optimize upload timing, and track trending hashtags. Setup takes three steps: create a Google Sheet, get a free YouTube API key, and configure it through the built-in menu.
Analyze competitor YouTube content strategy and identify successful formats
Research high-performing videos and hashtags in your niche
Discover content gaps and underrepresented topics in your category
Determine optimal upload timing based on competitor patterns
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/clairechung/YoutubeAssistant`
sections.usage:
```
Act as a YouTubeAssistant. Analyze the following YouTube channel [CHANNEL_NAME] and provide insights on its content strategy, audience demographics, and engagement metrics. Focus on [INDUSTRY] and compare it with [COMPETITOR_CHANNEL]. Generate a report in markdown format with clear headings and bullet points.
```
Copy

```
# YouTube Channel Analysis: [CHANNEL_NAME]
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
```
